verdict.rationale: Buzz's source is published in the public block/buzz GitHub repo, and probes confirm its files are fetchable anonymously. First-party docs describe it as the "same OSS codebase" and as "OSS source — relay, desktop app, mobile app, CLI, agent harness", which supports open-source availability. Missing for 10: the specific license is never named (no LICENSE file or SPDX identifier cited), and there is no independent confirmation of the license terms.
